title: Bound the selected BIT role digit by 2^(H1+13) (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped proof. No new κ. The selected frontier stays `781451/250000000`.

For the ordinary BIT stage retained by `certificates/frontier6030/CLAIM.json` (admitted saving `17/5000`, rank `N = 2^H1` with `H1 = 25986965159937`), the inherited nested-width bound used by `research/lockstep-live-role-audit/constant_c.py` gives an integer

```text
X = 471715391583208384
```

such that the stock formula's productive role count satisfies `log2(B) < N*X`. Combined with the recorded prime rule `q > 2^26*N^5`,

```text
c_B = ceil(log_q B) <= 2^(H1+13) <= N^2.
```

PR #4954's sufficient guard at `log2(e) >= 52182660963735` therefore no longer needs a role count beyond that inherited bound, once the cited reading `S_old = 1` from PR #4970 is used. The six-bit gap below the guard is unchanged. This does not materialize `B`, re-prove the compiler census, admit a supplier, or discharge the five framework assumptions.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`. Task `selected-stock-envelope`, scope refined: one selected-stage coefficient, the role digit of this BIT stage, rather than a new stock envelope or a cutoff rerun.

The band note (PR #4954) asserts that `c_B <= N^2` follows from the nested-width bound and does not compute the digit. PR #4970 derives `S_old = 1` and leaves `c_B` open. The m=73 envelope, the log_q parent correction, and the two-round cube stock are different objects. Local overlap search covered the working-tree notes at this base and did not find another derivation of this digit; open-PR and Discussion coverage was not refreshed in that cache.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python3 -B research/bit-role-digit-bound/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/bit-role-digit-bound/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-role-digit-bound
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-role-digit-bound --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The verifier recomputes `X` from the pinned BIT invoice, checks `X < 2^13*(5*H1+26)` and `H1+13 <= 2*H1`, and rejects rank 12 and an upper bound shifted by the full slack. Marker:

```text
PASS_BIT_ROLE_DIGIT c_B<=2^(H1+13)<=N^2 X=471715391583208384 no_new_kappa
```

`research_selected_baseline.py` reports bindings only (`PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`). `make frontier6030-verify` was not run. No Lean proof and no supplier replay.

Upstream `main` was fetched again before the commit and was still `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`.

## Credit

JoyboyBrian: PR #4954, the band theorem and the open `c_B <= N^2` hypothesis. James Reed: PR #4970, `S_old = 1`. Mark (Matarener): the nested-width formula as used in `research/lockstep-live-role-audit`. zxv: the delayed-cover stock formula. The selected claim is PR #6030.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can a `D = 2` depth lemma, rather than a smaller `c_B`, move the sufficient guard below `t = 52182660963735`? The role digit is now at most `2^(H1+13)`, negligible beside `N^2*w`, so it does not close the six-bit gap. The smallest follow-up is an exact comparison of `D*(N^2*w + c_B)` with `e/4` at `D = 2` and `w = ceil(e^(1/250))`. It is blocked by the slack the published band proof spends on the exponent arithmetic.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The package generator and pinned-source replay made the digit comparison easy to check. Overlap search against open PRs needed a live refresh that this session did not complete; a cached open-PR snapshot at the current base would have made that check local. Feedback discussion: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
